entities.name: Sodium hypochlorite
observations: Treatment of purified E. faecalis LTA was reported to deacylate its glycolipid moiety, abolishing TLR2 activation and reducing inflammatory mediator induction (PMID:27520407).

entities.name: E. faecalis LTA
observations: NaOCl-treated purified LTA showed reduced induction of nitric oxide, IP-10, and MIP-1α in RAW 264.7 cells and did not activate TLR2; structural analysis attributed damage to deacylation (PMID:27520407).

entities.name: TLR2
observations: The direct study reported that NaOCl-treated E. faecalis LTA no longer activated TLR2 (PMID:27520407).

entities.name: PMID:27520407
observations: Study: Sodium Hypochlorite Inactivates Lipoteichoic Acid of Enterococcus faecalis by Deacylation. DOI:10.1016/j.joen.2016.06.018.
